lines.t: Verse 1
Morning light on the window frame
Waves of gold and a gentle haze
I was restless, but the feeling changed
When the warmth came and the fear gave way
Pre-Chorus
Now I breathe in, let the noise go quiet
Every heavy thought starts to lose its fire
There’s a peace I can’t explain
Like the sky got close and spoke my name
Chorus
I’m walking in the sunlight,
Heart open wide
Even after all the gray skies
Hope is still alive
If the night comes near me,
I won’t be alone
YahuShua leads me forward
And I’m coming home
Verse 2
Footsteps soft on the open road
Every mile feels like a mercy shown
I was waiting for the clouds to break
Now I see how the colors stay
Pre-Chorus
And I breathe in, let the fear fade out
All the broken pieces turning round
There’s a fire that won’t die
It keeps burning bright inside my life
Chorus
I’m walking in the sunlight,
Heart open wide
Even after all the gray skies
Hope is still alive
If the night comes near me,
I won’t be alone
YahuShua leads me forward
And I’m coming home
Bridge
No more running from the shadows
No more hiding in the rain
With every step, You’re making new life
And I will sing Your name
Final Chorus
I’m walking in the sunlight,
Heart open wide
Even after all the gray skies
Hope is still alive
If the night comes near me,
I won’t be alone
YahuShua leads me forward
And I’m coming home
